import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Survival by passenger class and gender
survival_pclass_sex = df.groupby(['pclass', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().unstack()
survival_pclass_sex.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[0, 0], color=['lightcoral', 'lightblue'])
axes[0, 0].set_title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Gender', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_xticklabels(['First', 'Second', 'Third'], rotation=0)
axes[0, 0].legend(['Female', 'Male'], title='Gender')
axes[0, 0].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age distribution by survival status
survived_ages = df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()
not_survived_ages = df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna()

axes[0, 1].hist([survived_ages, not_survived_ages], 
                bins=20, 
                color=['lightgreen', 'lightcoral'], 
                alpha=0.7, 
                label=['Survived', 'Did not survive'],
                edgecolor='black')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].legend()
axes[0, 1].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Survival rate by embarkation port
embark_survival = df.groupby('embark_town')['survived'].mean().sort_values()
embark_survival.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[0, 2], color='skyblue', edgecolor='black')
axes[0, 2].set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Port', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('Embarkation Port', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_xticklabels(axes[0, 2].get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
axes[0, 2].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Add value labels on bars
for i, v in enumerate(embark_survival):
    axes[0, 2].text(i, v + 0.01, f'{v:.2f}', ha='center', fontsize=10)

# 4. Fare distribution by passenger class
fare_data = [df[df['pclass'] == i]['fare'].dropna() for i in range(1, 4)]
box = axes[1, 0].boxplot(fare_data, patch_artist=True, labels=['First', 'Second', 'Third'])
colors = ['lightblue', 'lightgreen', 'lightcoral']
for patch, color in zip(box['boxes'], colors):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Fare Distribution by Passenger Class', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Fare', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 5. Survival by family size (sibsp + parch)
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch'] + 1
family_survival = df.groupby('family_size')['survived'].mean()
axes[1, 1].plot(family_survival.index, family_survival.values, marker='o', 
                linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='darkorange')
axes[1, 1].fill_between(family_survival.index, family_survival.values, 
                        alpha=0.2, color='darkorange')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Survival Rate by Family Size', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Family Size (including passenger)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(range(1, 12))
axes[1, 1].grid(alpha=0.3)

# 6. Survival rate by age groups and gender
df['age_group'] = pd.cut(df['age'], bins=[0, 12, 18, 30, 50, 80], 
                         labels=['Child', 'Teen', 'Young Adult', 'Adult', 'Senior'])
age_gender_survival = df.groupby(['age_group', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().unstack()

x = np.arange(len(age_gender_survival.index))
width = 0.35
axes[1, 2].bar(x - width/2, age_gender_survival['female'], width, 
               label='Female', color='lightpink', edgecolor='black')
axes[1, 2].bar(x + width/2, age_gender_survival['male'], width, 
               label='Male', color='lightblue', edgecolor='black')
axes[1, 2].set_title('Survival Rate by Age Group and Gender', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 2].set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 2].set_xticks(x)
axes[1, 2].set_xticklabels(age_gender_survival.index)
axes[1, 2].legend()
axes[1, 2].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Add value labels on bars
for i, (f_val, m_val) in enumerate(zip(age_gender_survival['female'], age_gender_survival['male'])):
    axes[1, 2].text(i - width/2, f_val + 0.01, f'{f_val:.2f}', ha='center', fontsize=9)
    axes[1, 2].text(i + width/2, m_val + 0.01, f'{m_val:.2f}', ha='center', fontsize=9)

# Adjust layout and add overall title
plt.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()
